system.description:
The blood of one Blood Brother is the blood of all; through the circle's shared bond you close a comrade's wounds though miles lie between you.

Spend a Blood Trait exactly as if healing one of your own wounds and declare which member of your circle you are mending, regardless of distance. You may spend up to five Blood Traits over the course of several turns to heal a circlemate's aggravated wound. This expenditure counts against your own per-turn healing limit, not your target's. Sanguinus retests with Empathy.
